description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maligathenna, Kandy Four-Gravets D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320290
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications, all falling under the Registration of Title Act. The content is primarily focused on land and property matters, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
